sents.zh: 今天下午，老师带我们去了看书的地方。
sents.en: This afternoon the teacher took us to the place with the books.

sents.zh: 一进去，大家就不说话了。
sents.en: The moment we went in, everyone stopped talking.

sents.zh: 因为里面很多人在看书。
sents.en: Because many people inside were reading.

sents.zh: 书从地上一直放到上面。
sents.en: The books went from the floor right up to the top.

sents.zh: 有的书很新，有的已经很旧了。
sents.en: Some books were new, some already old.

sents.zh: 老师说：“你们可以自己找想看的书。”
sents.en: The teacher said: "You may look for a book you want."

sents.zh: 我走了很久，最后找到一本讲古时候的书。
sents.en: I walked around a long time and at last found one about ancient times.

sents.zh: 我坐下来，一看就看了两个小时。
sents.en: I sat down and read for two hours straight.

sents.zh: 书里有皇帝，有长城，还有很长的路。
sents.en: In it were emperors, the Great Wall, and a very long road.

sents.zh: 我看得太认真，忘了时间。
sents.en: I read so intently that I forgot the time.

sents.zh: 老师叫我的时候，我才起来。
sents.en: Only when the teacher called me did I get up.

sents.zh: 妈妈说：“这么多，你看得完吗？”
sents.en: Mother said: "So many — can you finish them?"
